Release Notes: Tavily Research Pro v1.1.0
This update marks the evolution from a standard search utility to a professional-grade research engine. The skill has been rebranded from tavily-search to tavily-research-pro to reflect its expanded capabilities in data analysis and automated reporting.

🔄 Key Changes & New Features
1. Advanced Sentiment Analysis (New Tool)
Feature: Introduced sentiment.mjs.

Capability: Beyond simple searching, the tool now performs a "vibe check" on topics. It aggregates AI insights and search snippets to calculate a sentiment score, labeling results as Bullish, Bearish, or Neutral.

Use Case: Ideal for market research and public opinion monitoring.

2. Automated Industry Reporting (New Tool)
Feature: Introduced report.mjs.

Capability: A specialized script that transforms a single URL into a structured intelligence brief. It automatically extracts core content and appends professional analyst remarks with timestamps.

3. Enhanced Batch Extraction
Refinement: The extract.mjs script was streamlined for batch processing. While v1.0.0 focused on detailed error reporting, v1.1.0 is optimized for "Clean Content" output, making it easier for AI agents to consume raw data from multiple sources simultaneously.

4. UI & UX Improvements
Rich Formatting: The search output in search.mjs now includes visual cues like bold headers and emojis to improve readability for human operators.

Localization Support: Added multi-language support in output logs (including Chinese descriptions in scripts) to cater to a broader range of professional researchers.

How to Update
Ensure your TAVILY_API_KEY is still active in your environment variables.
